trial.jaymoskingdoms.under_way.1: Don't look at me, %s. Keep to it.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.tomorrow.0: Once a day is plenty, %s. Come back tomorrow.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.not_now.0: You're in no state, %s. Mend first.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.not_now.1: Not like this, %s. Rest and ask again.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.no_room.0: There's no room here, %s. Find open ground.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.called_off.0: You wandered off, %s. The trial's off.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.called_off.1: Gone from the circle, %s? Then it's over.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.shade.start.0: Something of yours has come loose and walks ahead of you, %s. See it off.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.shade.start.1: Mind your back, %s. It's wearing your pace.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.shade.done.0: Good. It knew you well, and still lost.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.shade.done.1: Well done, %s. It was only borrowed from you.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.shade.lost.1: The shade keeps its ground. Not today, %s.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.ward.start.0: Stand in the ring, %s, and don't leave it. Whatever comes, it's the ring that keeps.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.ward.start.1: The ring holds if you do, %s.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.ward.done.0: You held. Rings are only habits made visible.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.ward.lost.0: The ring wanted you in it, %s. Next time stay.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.ward.lost.1: It slipped, %s. Rings always do, at first.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.marked.start.0: Look closely, %s. One of them is lit, and only that one means it.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.marked.start.1: Four of them, %s. One glows. Mind your hand.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.marked.done.0: Sharp eyes, %s. Most swing at the wrong shadow.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.marked.lost.0: It got away from you, %s. Another time.
trial.jaymoskingdoms.marked.wrong.0: That one wasn't lit, %s. The trial's over.
